MedCat.evidence_source: [010_parent_measures] Parent measures included the Externalizing and Internalizing subscales of the Child Behavior Checklist (CBCL; Achenbach & Edelbrock, 1983) to assess the parents' perceptions of problem behaviors in their children and the Issues Checklist to assess the parents' reports of disagreements between parent and teen. For the purposes of the present study, a rationally-derived adolescent CBCL "depression" score was developed. Four of the authors reviewed all 118 CBCL items and identified those which they believed represented the core symptoms of a depressive disorder in adolescents, using DSM III-R criteria for major depression as a guide.
